## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and followed the conventions.
- [ ] Public APIs follow the stability rules (`API_STABILITY.md`); no
      rewriting of stable features without a migration plan.
- [ ] Tests cover the change (`pnpm --filter <pkg> test`).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm test` pass locally.
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` passes (or I ran `pnpm format`).
- [ ] Docs updated where user-facing (`apps/docs/guide/**`, changelogs).
- [ ] A changeset is included for user-visible changes (`pnpm changeset`).
- [ ] Perf-sensitive changes were sanity-checked with `pnpm bench`.
